text:
DeployBot: preflight snapshot for release v2.9.4 starting now. checks: SLO-p95, 5xx, embed-route p99. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/abcd

Alex K: grabbing the snapshot. can someone eyeball embed-route p99? saw a tiny blip last night.

Priya S: on it — loading the chart now. if p99 > 250ms we'll flag. ping me in thread.

Josh M: quick reminder: pin v2.9.3->v2.9.4 rollout policy is staged-5%/50%/100% over 20m. keep an eye on error budget burn.

Lia R: question — do we run the extra KV cache sanity check for this deploy? it's a low-risk tweak but touching cache keys.

Alex K: yes, run `curl -sS http://deploy-checker.internal/kv-health | jq .ok` in canary. want the raw sample.

Priya S: ran it — returns "{\"ok\":true,\"latency_ms\":12}" on canary nodes. embedding p99 currently 198ms.

DeployBot: snapshot complete. p95: 64ms, p99: 198ms, 5xx: 0.02% (baseline 0.03%). no automated abort.

Josh M: nice. I'll start the 5% shift in 2m. @Priya S @Lia R stand by for quick triage if p99 jumps.

Priya S: copy. adding a dashboard watchlink and alert threshold: `embed-route-p99 > 300ms for 3m`.

Lia R: also watching KV miss rate — if miss rate + traffic > 0.5% we might hold.

Alex K: deploy started. rolling to 5%.

Priya S: seeing a tiny uptick to 210ms at 5% but still below threshold. no errors.

Josh M: increase to 50% now.

DeployBot: traffic shift to 50% complete.

Priya S: p99 at 50% 245ms — close to threshold. error rate steady. recommend continue but stay ready to pause.

Alex K: agreed. hold for 3m then go to 100% if stable.

Lia R: noted. KV miss at 0.12%.

DeployBot: scheduled final shift to 100% in 3m unless a hold message is posted.

Alex K: no hold. proceeding to 100%.

DeployBot: rollout to 100% complete. release v2.9.4 pinned. release-notes: https://docs.redwood/release/2.9.4

Priya S: post-deploy checks pass. closing the preflight thread. :tada:

Josh M: thanks everyone. I'll update the release note with the tiny observed p99 bump and the KV check we ran.

Lia R: filing a follow-up ticket to run a 6h perf sweep on embed routes — small risk but worth tracking.

Alex K: ack. good job team. :thumbsup:
